items.title: Sustainability tools to use in 2026
items.summary: Welcome to the Trellis roundup of new products and services for sustainability professionals, as chosen by our editorial team.

items.title: Netflix’s CSO quits for new storytelling role
items.summary: Netflix Chief Sustainability Officer Emma Stewart is leaving the company to join the leadership team at Climate Spring, a social enterprise focused on changing how climate change is represented in film, TV and popular culture.

items.title: Sustainability pays a credibility tax. Some of it is self-imposed
items.summary: The opinions expressed here by Trellis expert contributors are their own, not those of Trellis or its editors .

items.title: Reform-led Wakefield Council scraps 2030 net-zero target
items.summary: Wakefield Council has agreed to abandon its target of becoming a carbon-neutral authority by 2030 and reduce its climate change budget by £170,000.

items.title: Report: Existing grid connections in Europe could unlock 25GW of new clean power
items.summary: According to energy think tank Ember, 25 gigawatts (GW) of wind and solar could be added to existing EU hydropower sites without the need for new grid capacity.

items.title: Smart energy market risks deepening inequality without reform, report warns
items.summary: New research has found that the UK's transition to a smart, flexible electricity system risks creating a deeper divide between households unless fairness is built into market design, consumer support and regulation.

items.title: Octopus and Santander launch ‘first-of-its-kind’ mortgage for Zero Bills homes
items.summary: The new mortgage, designed specifically for Octopus Zero Bills homes, aims to make buying future-ready, lower-carbon houses more accessible.
